title: Aurora Dependency Register

definitions.meaning: An owner has been named and work has started; does not imply a date.

context_note: Register is updated at architecture syncs, which are held every two weeks. The sync planned for 10 Mar was cancelled.
content:
DEP-07 Meridian billing API v2. Meridian will retire API v1 on 31 March, so Aurora 3.2 must use v2. Status: Aurora client implemented against v2 specification. Sandbox credentials scoped for v2 requested from Meridian IT on 18 Feb; status pending as of 24 Feb. Owner: Solution Architect (our side), Meridian IT (their side).

DEP-09 Payline payment-gateway TLS certificate. Current certificate expires 20 March. Renewal status: in progress – Infra. Note: renewal process for client-branded domains may require client-side action.

DEP-11 Meridian SSO (Azure AD) configuration. Status: done, verified 12 Feb.
